name: scripts-in-type-gate
title: The instruments enter the type gate, and the type gate immediately pays for itself
description: tsconfig includes src, tests and .pi - not scripts, so the four readings, the blackbox and every command the guide tells a person to run were never type-checked. Widening it reveals two errors, and the first is a live defect: a gate-refusals prediction prints as =undefined in every turn output
